nodes.label: UserResponse DTO Implementation
nodes.rationale: Only @JsonIgnore on passwordHash prevents credential leaks, which is brittle. Returning DTOs prevents leaks and ensures consistent contracts.

nodes.label: Bean Validation with Spring Validation
nodes.rationale: Avoids manual validation with if-else checks, enabling declarative validation via spring-boot-starter-validation.

nodes.label: S3 Storage Provider Implementation
nodes.rationale: Implement real AWS S3 provider rather than stubbing storage operations. Use AWS SDK v2 for active maintenance and Netty non-blocking support.

nodes.label: JDK 21/22 and Kotlin Compatibility Workflow
nodes.rationale: Kotlin 2.1.0 requires <= JDK 22 but host runs JDK 25. Adding .java-version and checks warns developer early.

nodes.label: Apache POI Excel Workbook Usage
nodes.rationale: Apache POI is the de-facto standard for JVM Excel generation, supports both .xls and .xlsx, and handles SXSSFWorkbook for memory-efficient output.

nodes.label: Database-Level Filtering for Exports
nodes.rationale: Querying via JPA repository directly reduces memory overhead and prevents JVM Out-Of-Memory (OOM) risks on larger databases.

nodes.label: Spring-Managed Thread Task Executor
nodes.rationale: Spring-managed task executor executes storage migrations in compliance with container lifecycle to prevent memory leaks.

nodes.label: Extended WebP Magic Bytes Validation
nodes.rationale: Verifies container RIFF (bytes 0-3) and sub-identifier WEBP (bytes 8-11) to prevent other RIFF files (WAV, AVI) from bypassing verification.

nodes.label: Option A Nullable Columns Storage
nodes.rationale: Separate columns enable SQL querying (filter reports by customer, find all reports for a production line), indexing, and simpler serialization with Jackson's snake_case config. JSON metadata would require parsing logic for every read.

nodes.label: Local Parser Keyword Matching
nodes.rationale: The email format is consistent. A regex parser is deterministic, explainable, and doesn't need API calls or model downloads. The Gemini parser handles edge cases and format variations.

nodes.label: Gemini Schema Structured Output
nodes.rationale: Gemini's structured output gives strongly-typed, predictable JSON responses. Free-text prompting for JSON in the system prompt is less reliable.

nodes.label: DB Authoritative LDAP Config
nodes.rationale: The existing ldap_enabled/ldap_host/ldap_base_dn env vars in config.py create a dual-source-of-truth problem... Fix: remove those three fields from Settings, replace with a get_ldap_config() helper that reads app_settings at call time.

nodes.label: Fernet Encrypted Bind Credentials
nodes.rationale: Bind DN password is a privileged directory credential. Encrypt with JWT_SECRET... before writing; decrypt at connection time.

nodes.label: Deactivate-on-sync
nodes.rationale: Ex-employees with valid refresh tokens could use the app until token expiry (up to 7 days). Setting is_active = false and calling the existing token-revocation path... is immediate and consistent.

nodes.label: Spring Web MVC Stack
nodes.rationale: Spring Web (Servlet MVC) with Spring Data JPA. Standard transactions are simpler, more mature, and less prone to concurrency bugs in data-heavy transaction code. Eager fetching is handled cleanly via HQL JOIN FETCH.

nodes.label: Flyway Database Migration
nodes.rationale: Since we are getting rid of the Python environment entirely, we will drop Alembic and use Flyway. Flyway integrates natively with Spring Boot... and is fully compatible with GraalVM Native Image compilation.
